name: BRA pair self-transfer tax inflation
summary: BRA's _transfer() applied both buy and sell branches when the BRA/USDT pair transferred BRA to itself. With both 3% tax destinations configured to that pair, the function subtracted one tax but credited two, increasing the pair's BRA balance by 3% per skim(pair) call. Repeated skims created an unreserved BRA balance that the attacker swapped for the pair's USDT.
notes: setSellTaxTo() changed SellTaxTo from 0xd66d5a5aae741f5c070e2593226a88bc247fc07b to the BRA/USDT pair. BuyTaxTo had been set to the pair six blocks earlier, so this latest change completed the causal state in which a pair-to-pair transfer credited both taxes back to the pair.

The BRA/USDT pair received 271,699.541664092338012248 USDT and paid 458,917.996365062737064211 USDT in the anchor transaction, then received 272,015.801163809386555704 USDT and paid 313,093.941833611992770570 USDT in the second campaign transaction. Its exact transaction-local reserve depletions were 187,218.454700970399051963 and 41,078.140669802606214866 USDT. Their sum, 228,296.595370773005266829 USDT, is valued at stablecoin par; downstream WBNB proceeds are attacker profit rather than the gross victim loss.
